Name: SNES Livestock Dinosaurs
Author: cryomancer199x
Description:
[size=3]This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20357?tab=description]Item Extensions[/url]. Also has extra features if you also have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] and / or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry
[/url]I would suggest spacecore at least. Also an extra drop if you have [/size][size=3]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39239]Jerky Time[/url]﻿, and the meats from this mod can be used to make jerkies in that one.

[b]Features:[/b]
A new animal barn, the [b]Dinosaur Cave[/b]. It can be painted and provides auto-feeding. The hay will be reskinned while inside the cave to kibble.
Some [b]new buffs [/b]inspired by Chrono Trigger and Secret of Mana and some other stuff. Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] to work.
A slightly complicated system of produce even I don't fully understand but the short version is [b]more hearts = more potential items[/b].
[b]New for Version 2: Present Boxes. [/b]Some dinos can now produce gift boxes for you if they like you enough. Open them in-inventory with your shears to see what's inside, it can be a few different things.
[size=3][b]New for Version 2: Hostile Dinos. [/b]See below for more detail.[/size]
Some new [b]meat items and treat tastes[/b] if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url].﻿
Several [b]new creatures [/b]with several [b]new produce items [/b]and [b]several skins each[/b] (most have 5)
There are also a handful of alternate skins / sprites for some dinos if you dig around the folders. Nothing too crazy.
[b]Herbivores [/b]mostly like vegetables, fruits, and forage for AHM treats. [b]Carnivores [/b]like fish, eggs, and meat for AHM treats.[b]

[/b][/size][b][color=#b6d7a8][size=5]Non-hostile Dinos[/size][/color][/b]
[size=3]
[color=#000000][b]Woolly Mammoths[/b] [/color](technically based upon stardew's bear sprites but boy i changed a lot)[b]
[/b]Makes Mammoth Wool, Mammoth Milk, and sometimes Tusks.
Mammoth Meat with AHM. Flowers and Forage for treats.[/size][size=4]
[/size][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][b][size=4][color=#6fa8dc]Triceratops[/color] [/size][/b][size=3](based upon an unused graphic from Chrono Trigger)[/size][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][size=3]Makes Herbivore Teeth, Horns, sometimes Dino Skin or Inert Dinosaur Eggs, and one of the new buff items.
Dinosaur Meat with AHM. Herbivore treats.

[b][color=#93c47d][size=4]Stegosaurus [/size][/color][/b][size=3](based upon Dyna Brothers 2)[/size][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][size=3]Makes Dino Skin, Herbivore Teeth, Dorsal Plates, and Thagomizers (tail spikes). The stego items can be used to make new weapons.
Dinosaur Meat with AHM. Herbivore treats.
[size=3]
[b][color=#b4a7d6][size=4]Pterosaurs [/size][/color][/b][size=3](based upon Dyna Brothers 2)[/size][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][size=3]Makes Talons, Pycnofibers, Feathers, and three kinds of present boxes which might help you fill out fishing bundles. [color=#b4a7d6][b]T[/b][/color][b][color=#b4a7d6]hey will also harvest crops for you.[/color][/b]
Pterosaur Meat with AHM. Carnivore treats.
[/size][/size]
[size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][color=#93c47d][b][size=4]Drago [/size][/b][/color][size=3]([size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3]based on [/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]Mother 3)[/size][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][size=3]Only animal in this mod with baby form. Makes Dino Skin, Fangs, Petals, Sunflowers, and three kinds of present boxes that will give you various
flowers.
[size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3]Dinosaur [/size][/size]Meat with AHM. [size=3][size=3]Herbivore [/size][/size]treats.[/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]

[size=3][size=3][size=3][color=#fff2cc][b][size=4]Mudbeast [/size][/b][/color][size=3]([size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3]based on [/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]Chrono Trigger)[/size][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][size=3]Makes Talons, Clay, Horns, Life Elixirs, and a present box. 
Beast Meat with AHM. Carnivore treats.
[/size][/size][/size][/size]
[size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][color=#6aa84f][b][size=4]Wetnosaur [/size][/b][/color][size=3][color=#6aa84f] [/color](based on Earthbound)[/size][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][size=3]Makes Talons, Dino Skin, [size=3]Inert Dinosaur [/size]Eggs, and Luxury Jerky if you have my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39239]Jerky Time[/url]﻿ installed.
[size=3][size=3]Dinosaur [/size][/size]Meat with AHM. [size=3][size=3]Herbivore [/size][/size]treats.[/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]

[/size]
[b][size=5][color=#ffe599]Hostile Dinos[/color]

[/size][/b][size=3]Some dinos are now [b]attack animals who will hurt you[/b]. If you befriend them enough, they might [b]stop attacking[/b]. Many of them are pack animals though, so you'll probably need to befriend [b]more than one[/b] each.[/size]

[b][color=#ea9999][size=4]Raptors [/size][/color][/b][size=3](based on Secret of Evermore)[/size][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][size=3]Makes Talons, occasionally Feathers, Dino Skin, or Inert Dinosaur Eggs.
[size=3]Dinosaur Meat with AHM. [size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3]Carnivore treats.[/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]
[/size]
[b][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]Parasaurolophus[/size][/color][/b] aka Runners / Crested Leapers[size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][color=#fff2cc][b][size=4] [/size][/b][/color][size=3]([size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3]based on [/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]Chrono Trigger)[/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]
[size=3]Makes Herbivore Teeth, Horns, sometimes Dino Skin or Life Elixirs, and one of the new buff items.
[size=3]Dinosaur Meat with AHM. [size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3]Herbivore [/size][/size]treats.[/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]
[/size]
[b][size=4][color=#ffd966]Smilodon[/color] [/size][/b][size=3](based upon...an enemy from a dragon ball game on the GBA, that's SNES-adjacent right?? sprites heavily reworked by fellowclown)[/size]
[size=3]Makes Smilodon Fur and Fangs, as well as bone fragments. Smilodon Fur can be used to craft a new ring item that provides a buff if you have SpaceCore.[size=3]
Beast Meat with AHM. [size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3]Carnivore treats.[/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]

[/size][/size][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Chomposaur[/b][/size][/color][size=3] (based on Earthbound)
Makes Dino Skin, Fangs, [size=3]Inert Dinosaur [/size]Eggs. Can drop a present box that can contain either a new weapon or a somewhat rare one from vanilla.
[size=3][size=3]Dinosaur Meat with AHM. [size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3]Carnivore treats.[/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]

You can make the Mammoth Milk into Mammoth Cheese in a Cheese Maker. 
Empty Present Boxes can be recycled.
Jerky Time has custom jerky items for all the meats in this mod.

[b]Lore to justify some choices:
[/b]these are all genetically altered to be female, infertile, domesticated, and sometimes miniaturized. So they don't really have baby forms and do not reproduce. That will stay that way unless someone decides to volunteer to make all the baby sprites, lol. The elixirs and buff items are based on the in-game drops for the Runners. The Triceratops did not have a nose horn in it's original graphic, I've added one for most but not all of it's available skins. All skins are random (no conditions tho) and a few are a bit more rare. I suggest [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] if you'd like more control over which variants you buy.﻿ Many of the color choices are references to things, I'm not gonna bother listing them here but ask me in the comments if curious about any.


[b]Known issues:[/b]
[s]Dino Cave gate might have some weird graphics going on. The gate might also not actually stop the animals from entering and exiting.
New meat items can be used as treats for the carnivorous animals, but will likely show a vanilla graphic instead for some reason.[/s]
Sometimes, the dino kibble in the cave will mysteriously hover over the trough. This problem eludes myself and all who looked at it to help me. If you know better, let us know, cuz what the hell? It should fix itself if you sleep a couple times, probably.
[s]Smilodons probably need an alternative texture for when they're ready to get sheared. I suggest [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7098]UI Info Suite 2[/url], both in general and specifically for this case, as it will give you a little bubble indicating what animals have what produce ready.﻿[/s]
Runners will jump and sort of hang out midair for awhile sometimes. I don't know that I can fix that, and probably won't anyway because it amuses me.
The buff items are food and they probably shouldn't be. And one is a ring and probably shouldn't be. Might fix these next update.
I did only minor testing for running the mod without the optional dependencies, let me know if you do that and encounter specific issues.


[b]Future Plans:[/b] (because of course I am never free from feature creep)
I've got more animals planned. Know any 16-ish bit ancient creatures that have sprites walking in all directions that you'd love to see in here? Suggest it and I'll look at it. 
Would like to make some furniture and maybe clothes items. This will be the next update, most likely.
In the far future these will likely be unlockable content within a new region and all that biz but that's years away if it ever happens probably.

[b]Need more dinosaurs? [/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41921]Dino Expanded[/url] looks pretty cool. Haven't tried it but I imagine it can play nice with this? If anyone finds out lemme know.
